_about: Frame-review checklist for scorecard v2. status: open | review (fixed in code, not yet seen in frames; still counts as open) | closed (seen fixed, evidence given). severity: high | medium | low. Seeded from the 2026-11-11 full-game review (D:/TAGFullGame).

checks.title: Get-offs from the wrong side's pool (C fires off with a DL clip, DL with an OL pass-set or a guard pull)
Kick returner sprints in the crouched comeback-catch clip
No touchdown celebrations (183 clips loaded, none played)
Receivers sprint with an arm raised on run plays
At contact the rusher's torso passes into the blocker's shoulder
No help-up, ball to the official or varied jog back after the whistle
Jerseys and pants read as glossy plastic (no knit / twill)
No front jersey numbers
No helmet logos (fictional teams have no marks)
No shoulder/sleeve TV numbers
Kicker wears #82
Crowd near the sideline reads as low-detail cards in close shots
Chain-crew rods render as a slanted orange bar
Officials' uniforms: no numbers, the referee's white cap
Referee lines up 2-4 yd from the QB and ends up in the sack pile
Officials walk through players
One on-field official instead of a seven-man crew
Arms pass through helmets and shoulders in piles
Deep passes thrown past the end line, men running into the stands
checks.evidence: p1 telemetry: ball max x 111.3 (was 188.4); SimTests 'passes stay on the field'

checks.title: Linemen block 65 yd downfield on a breakaway
checks.evidence: 200 headless games: deepest engaged OL block 16 yd (was 48); SimTests leash

checks.title: Backup QBs rotate in mid-drive
checks.evidence: 200 games: 7 changes, all injuries; SimTests 'starters stay in'

checks.title: Coverage too loose at 10-19 yd after the movement limits (separation 3.2-3.6 yd)
CPU games stall at halftime
checks.evidence: p1 filmed game went through halftime on its own (commit 8e89838)

checks.title: Men still walking at the snap (illegal motion, teleport)
checks.evidence: p1: plays with a pop 61 -> 3, none at the snap

checks.title: Facemask tackle clips used as clean tackles, never flagged
Punts, field goals and extra points are canned animations, not played
Penalties are dice rolls, not from what happens on the field
Game clock frozen through the presnap (runoff applied after)
Kicked balls (punt/FG/PAT) fly on a scripted arc
Stale HUD: '1st & 10' on kickoffs, 'KICKOFF' on a PAT, a flag line through the next play
checks.evidence: fixed in 8e89838 (HudDown, ticker between plays); needs a frame check

checks.title: Camera lags the ball on long runs (tackle at the frame edge)
Kick result text floats in the scene
No first-down line or play-clock graphic
No stat overlays after big plays
